title: 馬克白 4-2~3 滅門與流亡
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Macduff, a burly thane with a thick unkempt red-brown beard, a jagged boar-tusk pendant at his neck, in a weathered grey-green tartan cloak

panels.prompt: a warm firelit hall in a Scottish castle, a noblewoman clutching her young son's shoulders while arguing with a gaunt thane in a travel-stained grey cloak

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫夫人
dialogue.text: 他把妻子兒女、宅第尊位一齊丟下，這算是明智嗎？最小的鷦鷯，也會為巢裡的雛鳥和貓頭鷹拚命！
dialogue.en: He loves us not; he wants the natural touch: for the poor wren, the most diminutive of birds, will fight, her young ones in her nest, against the owl.

panels.prompt: the grey-cloaked thane bowing out the doorway, unable to meet the woman's eyes, rain beginning outside

dialogue.speaker: 洛斯
dialogue.text: 時世太冷酷了——我們自己還不知道，就已經蒙上了叛徒的惡名。
dialogue.en: Cruel are the times, when we are traitors and do not know ourselves.

panels.prompt: a bright-eyed boy perched on a bench by the fire swinging his legs, chin up, bantering with his mother

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫子
dialogue.text: 爸爸沒有死。要是他真的死了，您會哭的；您不哭，我就有新爸爸了。
dialogue.en: If he were dead, you'ld weep for him: if you would not, it were a good sign that I should quickly have a new father.

panels.prompt: a breathless messenger gripping the doorframe of the hall, terror in his eyes, the fire guttering in the draft

dialogue.speaker: 使者
dialogue.text: 夫人，快帶著孩子逃——沒人道的事，就要落到您頭上了！
dialogue.en: Be not found here; hence, with your little ones! To fright you thus, methinks, I am too savage.

panels.prompt: long murderers' shadows falling across the firelit hall floor, a mother pushing her small son behind her skirts

dialogue.speaker: 刺客
dialogue.text: 你的丈夫呢？——他是個反賊。
dialogue.en: Where is your husband? … He's a traitor.

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫子
dialogue.text: 你胡說，你這蓬頭的惡人！

panels.prompt: the castle hall seen from outside through a leaded window, only violent shadows on the wall, birds bursting from the eaves into a grey sky

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫子
dialogue.text: 他殺死我了，媽媽——您快逃吧！
dialogue.en: He has killed me, mother: run away, I pray you!

panels.prompt: a quiet stone garden before an English palace, a young fair-haired prince in conversation with {characters} on a bench, autumn leaves drifting

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 讓我們找一處荒涼的樹蔭，把胸中的悲哀哭個痛快吧。
dialogue.en: Let us seek out some desolate shade, and there weep our sad bosoms empty.

panels.prompt: {characters}, turned away with a fist against his chest, eyes fixed on the horizon toward a stormy north

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 流血吧，流血吧，苦難的祖國！

quote.text: 流血吧，流血吧，苦難的祖國

panels.prompt: a gaunt grey-cloaked thane arriving travel-stained in the garden, hat in hand, unable to speak, the birds gone silent

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 我的妻子好嗎？我的孩子們呢？
dialogue.en: How does my wife? And all my children?

dialogue.speaker: 洛斯
dialogue.text: 你的城堡受到襲擊。妻子、孩子、僕人——殺得，一個不存。
dialogue.en: Your castle is surprised; your wife and babes savagely slaughtered.

panels.prompt: extreme close-up of a red-bearded face, hat brim pulled low over the eyes, one tear cutting a line through road dust

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 用言語把悲傷傾洩出來吧。無言的哀痛，會叫不堪重壓的心裂成片片。
dialogue.en: Give sorrow words: the grief that does not speak whispers the o'er-fraught heart and bids it break.

panels.prompt: {characters}, on his knees in the garden with fists clenched toward the sky, scattered autumn leaves whirling around him, grief tearing his face

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 我所有可愛的雞雛們，和他們的母親，一個也不存嗎？啊，地獄裡的惡鳥！——他自己，沒有兒女。
dialogue.en: All my pretty ones? Did you say all? O hell-kite! All? … He has no children.

quote.text: 我可愛的雞雛們，一個也不存嗎
quote.en: All my pretty ones? Did you say all?

panels.prompt: the young prince gripping the kneeling man's shoulder hard, jaw set

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 把這仇恨作為磨快劍鋒的礪石。讓哀痛變成憤怒——激起你心裡的怒火來！
dialogue.en: Be this the whetstone of your sword: let grief convert to anger; blunt not the heart, enrage it.

panels.prompt: {characters}, rising to his feet and drawing his sword, holding it point-down before him like a vow, wind tearing leaves through the garden

dialogue.speaker: 麥克德夫
dialogue.text: 仁慈的上天，撤除一切障礙——讓我跟這蘇格蘭的惡魔正面相對，我的劍夠得到他就好！
dialogue.en: Gentle heavens, cut short all intermission; front to front bring thou this fiend of Scotland and myself; within my sword's length set him.

panels.prompt: an army mustering before the English palace at dawn, war banners rising against the pale sky, heavy black title-card borders

dialogue.speaker: 馬爾康
dialogue.text: 麥克白氣數將絕，天誅將至。黑夜無論怎樣悠長，白晝總會到來。
dialogue.en: Macbeth is ripe for shaking, and the powers above put on their instruments. The night is long that never finds the day.

quote.text: 黑夜無論怎樣悠長，白晝總會到來
quote.en: The night is long that never finds the day.
